ordRep.title: Orders
ordRep.sub: Ordered value (on the day an order was placed) and Sales (on the day it was delivered), day by day, by delivery zone and by payment method.

day.title: Day by day
day.sub: The days of the period with an order placed or delivered, the newest first.

zone.title: By delivery zone
zone.sub: The order’s delivery zone; “Not settled” is an order whose address was not read into a zone.

pay.title: By payment method
pay.sub: How the order is paid; “Not recorded” is an order with no method yet.

ordRep.note: Sales count delivered orders on their delivery day, so a day can show Sales without orders placed. Figures are the shop’s own order totals; nothing here changes an order or a price.
